verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮੁ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh safal jana(n)m jag vich aaiaa|

en.bdb: Blest is the birth of a gurmukh and his coming to this world.
In accordance with the wisdom of the Guru he deletes his ego and accomplishes the (virtuous) actions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਮ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau bhagat kar ka(n)m sukh fal paiaa|

en.bdb: He works controlled by his love for work and loving devotion, and receives the pleasure fruit (of life).
The inaccessible teachings of the Guru he adopts in his heart.
Keeping of the flag of forbearance and dharma high, becomes his innate nature.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹੈ ਨ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit_en: sahai na dhookh saha(n)m bhaanaa bhaiaa ||10||

en.bdb: He bows before the will of the Lord and never suffers any fear or sorrow.
